linear.title: Linear Cutting Calculator | Cut List Calculator
linear.heading: Linear Cutting Calculator
linear.promise: Enter your stock lengths and pieces, get an efficient cut layout instantly.
linear.howTo.step1: Enter the stock bar length (and kerf if needed) in the Settings section.
linear.howTo.step2: Add each piece type: its length and how many copies you need.
linear.howTo.step3: Press Calculate to see the cut layout and waste summary.
linear.howTo.step4: Check the diagram or cut list, then verify measurements before cutting.
settings.unitsHint: Choose the unit for all lengths.
settings.stockHint: Enter one length per row. Leave quantity blank for unlimited.
settings.stockQtyHint: Number of bars available, or blank for unlimited.
settings.kerfHint: Width of material removed by each cut. Enter 0 or leave blank if not needed.
settings.kerfAfterLastLabel: Count kerf after the last piece on each bar
settings.kerfAfterLastHint: When on, one extra kerf width is deducted per bar. Use this if your saw always makes a final trim cut.
settings.kerfRuleNote: Default kerf rule: kerf is counted between pieces only (n pieces → n−1 cuts per bar). Enable the option above to also count a kerf after the last piece.
